questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates the candidate's ability to design end-to-end tenant onboarding, isolation, governance, and observability in Azure DevOps at production scale.

## Key Concepts
- Parameterized YAML templates and conditional deployment
- Per-tenant resource isolation: Resource Group, App Service plan, deployment slot
- App Configuration and Key Vault integration
- Database seeding and tenant-specific tests in isolated environments
- Policy gates and drift detection
- Rollback strategy and per-tenant auditing to Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none

parameters:
  - name: tenantId
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant ID'
  - name: tenantDomain
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant Domain'

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-spn'
  subscriptionId: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID)'
  resourceGroupName: 'rg-$(tenantId)'
  appServicePlanName: 'asp-$(tenantId)'
  appServiceName: 'api-$(tenantId)'
  appConfigName: 'appconfig-$(tenantId)'
  keyVaultName: 'kv-shared-01'
  databaseServerName: 'sql-$(tenantId)'
  databaseName: 'db-$(tenantId)'

stages:
  - stage: Provision
    displayName: 'Provision Tenant Resources'
    jobs:
      - job: ProvisionResources
        displayName: 'Provision Infrastructure'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create --name $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az configure --defaults group=$(resourceGroupName)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service Plan'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az appservice plan create --name $(appServicePlanName) --sku S1 --is-linux

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service with Deployment Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp create --name $(appServiceName) --plan $(appServicePlanName) --runtime 'NODE|18-lts'
                az webapp deployment slot create --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create SQL Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az sql server create --name $(databaseServerName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az sql db create --name $(databaseName) --server $(databaseServerName) --service-tier Basic

  - stage: Configure
    displayName: 'Configure Tenant'
    dependsOn: Provision
    jobs:
      - job: LoadConfiguration
        displayName: 'Load Settings and Secrets'
        steps:
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Fetch Tenant Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Configure App Settings'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp config appsettings set --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging --settings \
                  TENANT_ID=$(tenantId) \
                  TENANT_DOMAIN=$(tenantDomain) \
                  DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING='Server=tcp:$(databaseServerName).database.windows.net,1433;Database=$(databaseName);User ID=$(keyVaultTenantUser);Password=$(keyVaultTenantPassword);Encrypt=true;'

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Seed Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                sqlcmd -S $(databaseServerName).database.windows.net -d $(databaseName) -U $(keyVaultTenantUser) -P $(keyVaultTenantPassword) -i seed-tenant.sql

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy to Staging'
    dependsOn: Configure
    jobs:
      - job: DeployApplication
        displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
        steps:
          - task: AzureWebApp@1
            displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'webApp'
              appName: $(appServiceName)
              deployToSlotOrASE: true
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              slotName: 'staging'

  - stage: Test
    displayName: 'Run Tests'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: RunTests
        displayName: 'Execute Tenant Tests'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm test -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm run test:integration -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

  - stage: GateAndPolicy
    displayName: 'Policy Gates & Drift Check'
    dependsOn: Test
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyCheck
        displayName: 'Verify Policy Compliance'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicy@0
            displayName: 'Check Azure Policy Compliance'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              definitionId: '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/...' 

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Drift Detection'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group show --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --name initial-deployment
                # Compare current state with desired state

  - stage: Promote
    displayName: 'Promote to Production'
    dependsOn: GateAndPolicy
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: SwapSlots
        displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              WebAppName: $(appServiceName)
              ResourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              SourceSlot: 'staging'

  - stage: Audit
    displayName: 'Audit & Logging'
    dependsOn: Promote
    jobs:
      - job: LogAuditTrail
        displayName: 'Send Audit Logs to Azure Monitor'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Tenant Onboarding'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insights trace show \
                  --location eastus \
                  --query "[?operationName == 'tenant-onboarding']"

                # Send custom event
                az monitor app-insights events show --app $(appInsightsName) --type customEvents
```

This YAML pipeline demonstrates a complete tenant onboarding workflow with infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, testing, policy enforcement, and production deployment with full audit logging capabilities.

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question tests mastery of multi-tenant AKS deployment patterns, secrets management at scale, advanced deployment strategies, and operational monitoring. It challenges candidates to integrate Azure DevOps with Kubernetes-native delivery tools while maintaining tenant isolation and operational reliability.

## Key Concepts

- **Multi-tenant AKS**: Isolated Kubernetes namespaces per tenant with dedicated RBAC policies
- **Secrets Management**: Azure Key Vault integration via Secrets Store CSI driver for per-tenant secret injection
- **Progressive Deployments**: Argo Rollouts canary strategy with weighted traffic shifting across regions
- **Drift Detection**: Automated comparison between GitOps manifests and live cluster state with automatic rollback on divergence
- **Governance**: Azure Policy enforcement and manual approval gates before production deployment
- **Observability**: Azure Monitor Logs for centralized log aggregation and alerting

## Code Example

```yaml
# Azure DevOps multi-tenant deployment pipeline skeleton
trigger: none

parameters:
  - name: tenantId
    type: string
    displayName: 'Tenant Identifier'

variables:
  - group: 'tenant-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'
  - name: aksCluster
    value: 'aks-prod-cluster'
  - name: namespace
    value: 'tenant-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'

stages:
  - stage: Validate
    displayName: 'Validate & Scan'
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyCheck
        displayName: 'Azure Policy Validation'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicyCheck@0
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'aks-spn'
              policyDefinition: '/subscriptions/$(subId)/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/aks-namespace-isolation'

      - job: DriftDetection
        displayName: 'Manifest vs Cluster Drift'
        steps:
          - task: KubernetesManifest@0
            inputs:
              action: 'annotate'
              namespace: '$(namespace)'
              annotations: |-
                manifestHash=$(Build.SourceVersion)
          - task: Bash@3
            name: check_drift
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                # Compare live cluster state with repo manifests
                kubectl diff -n $(namespace) -f manifests/
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=hasDrift;isOutput=true]$(diff found)"

  - stage: Deploy_Canary
    displayName: 'Canary Deployment'
    dependsOn: Validate
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployCanary
        environment: 'aks-canary'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: Kubernetes@1
                  inputs:
                    connectionType: 'Kubernetes Service Connection'
                    namespace: '$(namespace)'
                    manifests: 'manifests/$(tenantId)/*'
                - task: ArgoRollouts@0
                  inputs:
                    connection: 'argo-rollouts-spn'
                    rolloutName: 'api-$(tenantId)'
                    strategy: 'canary'
                    canaryWeight: 25
                    step: 'setWeight'

  - stage: Shift_Traffic
    displayName: 'Progressive Traffic Shift'
    dependsOn: Deploy_Canary
    jobs:
      - job: RolloutToRegion
        steps:
          - task: ArgoRollouts@0
            inputs:
              connection: 'argo-rollouts-spn'
              rolloutName: 'api-$(tenantId)'
              strategy: 'canary'
              canaryWeight: 100
              step: 'setWeight'
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            inputs:
              connectedServiceName: 'azure-monitor-workspace'
              alertRules: 'alerts/canary-failure.json'

  - stage: Production
    displayName: 'Production Gate'
    dependsOn: Shift_Traffic
    jobs:
      - job: ManualApproval
        displayName: 'Require Approval'
        pool: server
        timeoutInMinutes: 1440
        steps:
          - task: ManualValidation@0
            timeoutInMinutes: 1440
            inputs:
              instructions: 'Approve production deployment for tenant ${{ parameters.tenantId }}'
              onTimeout: 'reject'

      - job: DeployProduction
        displayName: 'Deploy to Production'
        dependsOn: ManualApproval
        steps:
          - task: Kubernetes@1
            inputs:
              connectionType: 'Kubernetes Service Connection'
              namespace: '$(namespace)'
              manifests: 'manifests/prod/*'
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            inputs:
              connectedServiceName: 'azure-monitor-workspace'
              logsType: 'Azure Kubernetes Service'
```

- How do you ensure secrets rotation without pod restart?
- What metrics trigger automatic rollback in canary deployments?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Is Asked

This question assesses practical ability to design reusable CI/CD pipelines with templates, conditional logic, and enterprise-grade configurations in an Azure environment.

## Key Concepts

- **Azure DevOps YAML templates** for modular, maintainable pipeline design
- **Conditional deployment workflows** for PR validation versus production releases
- **Azure App Configuration** feature flags enabling controlled canary rollouts
- **Azure Key Vault** integration for secure secret and credential management
- **App Service deployment slots** for zero-downtime releases with traffic splitting
- **Health checks** with logging to Azure Monitor for operational visibility

## Code Example

### Main Pipeline (`azure-pipelines.yml`)

```yaml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
      - 'release/*'

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  - group: microservice-vars
  - template: templates/variables/service-names.yml

stages:
  - template: templates/stages/validation.yml
    parameters:
      services: $[ dependencies.prep.outputs['Setup.services'] ]

  - template: templates/stages/build.yml
    parameters:
      services:
        - name: service-a
          appName: $(service-a-app-name)
          slotName: staging
        - name: service-b
          appName: $(service-b-app-name)
          slotName: staging

  - template: templates/stages/deploy.yml
    parameters:
      condition: eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')
      services:
        - name: service-a
          appName: $(service-a-app-name)
          canaryPercentage: 10
        - name: service-b
          appName: $(service-b-app-name)
          canaryPercentage: 10
```

### Validation Stage Template (`templates/stages/validation.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

stages:
  - stage: Validation
    displayName: PR Validation
    condition: eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest')
    jobs:
      - job: RunTestsAndLint
        displayName: Test and Lint
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: UseDotNet@2
            displayName: Setup .NET SDK
            inputs:
              packageType: 'sdk'
              version: '8.0.x'

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/test.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                workingDirectory: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/${{ service.name }}

          - template: ../jobs/lint.yml
            parameters:
              services: ${{ parameters.services }}
```

### Build Stage Template (`templates/stages/build.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

stages:
  - stage: Build
    displayName: Build Services
    jobs:
      - job: Build
        displayName: Build and Publish
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - checkout: self

          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: Fetch Secrets
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
              KeyVaultName: '$(keyvault-name)'
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/build.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                appName: ${{ service.appName }}
                workingDirectory: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/${{ service.name }}
```

### Deploy Stage Template (`templates/stages/deploy.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object
  - name: condition
    type: string
    default: ''

stages:
  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: Deploy to Production
    condition: ${{ parameters.condition }}
    jobs:
      - job: DeployServices
        displayName: Deploy All Services
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
            displayName: Enable Canary Feature Flag
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
              Action: 'Update feature flags'
              Feature Flag Name: 'CanaryRelease'
              Connection: 'app-config-connection'

          - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
            - template: ../jobs/deploy.yml
              parameters:
                serviceName: ${{ service.name }}
                appName: ${{ service.appName }}
                canaryPercentage: ${{ service.canaryPercentage }}

          - template: ../jobs/health-check.yml
            parameters:
              services: ${{ parameters.services }}
```

### Build Job Template (`templates/jobs/build.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: appName
    type: string
  - name: workingDirectory
    type: string

jobs:
  - job: Build_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Build ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    steps:
      - script: |
          dotnet build -c Release
        workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}
        displayName: Build Service

      - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
        displayName: Publish Service
        inputs:
          command: 'publish'
          publishWebProjects: true
          arguments: -c Release -o $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
          workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}

      - publish: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
        artifact: ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
        displayName: Publish Artifacts
```

### Test Job Template (`templates/jobs/test.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: workingDirectory
    type: string

jobs:
  - job: Test_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Run Tests - ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    steps:
      - task: UseDotNet@2
        inputs:
          packageType: 'sdk'
          version: '8.0.x'

      - script: dotnet test --logger trx --results-directory $(TestResultsDirectory)
        workingDirectory: ${{ parameters.workingDirectory }}
        displayName: Run Unit Tests

      - task: PublishTestResults@2
        displayName: Publish Test Results
        inputs:
          testResultsFormat: 'VSTest'
          testResultsFiles: '$(TestResultsDirectory)/*.trx'
          failOnMinTestsNotMet: true
          minTestsNotMetImpact: 'testFailureThreshold'
```

### Lint Job Template (`templates/jobs/lint.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

jobs:
  - job: Lint
    displayName: Run Linting
    steps:
      - task: UseDotNet@2
        inputs:
          packageType: 'sdk'
          version: '8.0.x'

      - script: |
          dotnet tool install --global dotnet-format || true
          for dir in ${{ join(' ', parameters.services.*.name) }}; do
            dotnet-format --folder $dir --verify-no-changes || exit 1
          done
        displayName: Run Linter
```

### Deploy Job Template (`templates/jobs/deploy.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: serviceName
    type: string
  - name: appName
    type: string
  - name: canaryPercentage
    type: number
    default: 0

jobs:
  - deployment: Deploy_${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    displayName: Deploy ${{ parameters.serviceName }}
    environment: 'production-${{ parameters.serviceName }}'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
            - task: AzureWebApp@1
              displayName: Deploy to App Service Slot
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
                appType: 'webApp'
                appName: ${{ parameters.appName }}
                slotName: 'production'
                package: $(Build.ArtifactStagingDirectory)/${{ parameters.serviceName }}
                deploymentMethod: 'auto'

            - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
              displayName: Set Canary Traffic
              inputs:
                azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
                Action: 'Update feature flags'
                Feature Flag Name: '${{ parameters.serviceName }}.CanaryPercentage'
                Connection: 'app-config-connection'
                Value: ${{ parameters.canaryPercentage }}

            - script: |
                az webapp traffic-routing set --name ${{ parameters.appName }} --distribution ${{ parameters.serviceName }}.prod=90;${{ parameters.serviceName }}.canary=${{ parameters.canaryPercentage }}
              displayName: Configure Traffic Routing
```

### Health Check Job Template (`templates/jobs/health-check.yml`)

```yaml
parameters:
  - name: services
    type: object

jobs:
  - job: HealthCheck
    displayName: Verify Service Health
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
      - ${{ each service in parameters.services }}:
        - script: |
            response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://${{ service.appName }}.azurewebsites.net/health)
            if [ "$response" -ne 200 ]; then
              echo "Health check failed for ${{ service.name }}"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "${{ service.name }} health check passed"
          displayName: Health Check - ${{ service.name }}

      - task: AzureCLI@2
        displayName: Log to Azure Monitor
        inputs:
          azureSubscription: 'azure-connection'
          scriptType: 'bash'
          scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
          inlineScript: |
            az monitor app-insights query --app ${{ parameters.services[0].appName }} --analytics-query "requests | where success == true | summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 5m)"
```

## Template Structure Overview

```
templates/
├── stages/
│   ├── validation.yml      # PR: test + lint only
│   ├── build.yml           # Build and package services
│   └── deploy.yml          # Production deployment with canary
├── jobs/
│   ├── build.yml           # Compile and publish artifacts
│   ├── test.yml            # Run unit tests
│   ├── lint.yml            # Code quality checks
│   ├── deploy.yml          # Deploy to App Service with traffic routing
│   └── health-check.yml    # Verify endpoints and log to Monitor
└── variables/
    └── service-names.yml   # Per-environment service configuration
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates a candidate's ability to design a CI/CD pipeline that enforces governance gates before deployment while enabling rapid feedback through ephemeral environments.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Policy integration as a CI/CD gate
- AKS ephemeral namespace deployment
- Helm-based deployments with per-environment configuration
- Azure Key Vault and Azure App Configuration integration
- Health checks and automatic rollback mechanisms
- Azure Monitor logging for traceability

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
pr: none

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: BuildAndTest
        pool:
          vmImage: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '20.x'
          - script: npm install && npm test
  
  - stage: PolicyCheck
    jobs:
      - job: AKSComplianceCheck
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(AZURE_SERVICE_CONNECTION)
              script: |
                az policy state list \
                  --resource-group $(AKS_RESOURCE_GROUP) \
                  --filter "complianceState eq 'NonCompliant'"
  
  - stage: Deploy
    dependsOn: PolicyCheck
    jobs:
      - job: DeployToEphemeralNS
        steps:
          - task: HelmInstaller@1
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            script: |
              NAMESPACE="pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)"
              helm upgrade --install $NAMESPACE ./chart \
                --namespace $NAMESPACE --create-namespace \
                --set env=$(DEPLOYMENT_ENV)
  
  - stage: Validate
    jobs:
      - job: HealthCheck
        steps:
          - script: |
              curl -f http://$NAMESPACE.health || exit 1
      - job: RollbackOnFailure
        condition: failed()
        steps:
          - script: helm uninstall $NAMESPACE
```

trigger:
- main
